meta.notice: Pandal locations are confirmed and usable for directions. Traffic restrictions, goods-vehicle points, bus departure points, NJP routes and parking places follow the Siliguri Police Puja 2026 traffic arrangements; general parking rules are from local press reports. Maps show approximate junction-to-junction lines only. Police Assistance Booths are mapped to landmarks; 2026 deployment and exact booth positions are pending verification. DEMO facility records are samples only. Official branding is disabled until written approval.

trafficPlan.note: End times are on the next morning. Police may change timings at short notice depending on crowds.
trafficPlan.immersion: Idol immersion is scheduled for 21, 22, 23 and 24 Oct 2026. Immersion routes and ghat-wise traffic arrangements have not been published for visitors.

parkingRules.text: No roadside parking on main roads during the Puja days. Vehicles parked there may be towed.
parkingRules.source: Local press reports (Millennium Post, 8 Oct; SP News, 11 Oct)

parkingRules.text: Vehicles are not allowed into roads where pandals stand. Park at a listed place and walk.
Electronic display boards at key junctions will show parking and traffic information.
Park only in earmarked places, never in a No Parking area. Big pujas arrange parking with the police, so ask volunteers at the pandal.
